ReferenceTextures — TEST PLACEHOLDERS, project-owned.

Made by Tools/reference_textures.py (October 11, 2026) from the project's own reference
renders in Docs/LayoutReferences, which the user supplied for this project. Walnut,
VelvetCharcoal, SuedeCream and SafeSteel are crops of those renders (lighting flattened,
made seamless); FloorTile, StoneTop, BronzeBrushed, PlasterWarm, PavementSlab and
AsphaltWet are synthesised with colours sampled from them. No third-party material.

These are a test ride only. The user will supply final textures: drop files with the
same names (<Name>_Color.png, <Name>_Normal.png) into this folder to replace them;
StoreKit and the night store pick them up without code changes.
